build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: native Scene part-command adoption (PartToggle, apply/set, key mapping, HUD checkboxes); authority endpoint and old-client forwarding unchanged
ownership.mit: existing render-core frames/instances and render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue unchanged; no game logic moved into MIT crates
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

command_contract.endpoint: unchanged FlightAuthority::apply_part_command with the explicit VehiclePartCommand values the old pilot sends (RCS/wheels/gear/chutes); built-ins infallible for the starter vehicle
command_contract.native_keys: R/Y/G/P toggle through Scene::apply_part_toggle (read-back + explicit command); repeats/consumed gated like the other discrete inputs; non-vehicle modes ignore them
command_contract.hud: four checkboxes adopting on change only (no per-frame command spam); systems readout line; live-flight section only
command_contract.telemetry: rcs/wheels/gear/chutes appended to the flight status line
command_contract.failure_boundary: unexpected rejection stops the flight like a physics error (no panic), preserving the last valid presentation
command_contract.forwarding_boundary: old client still queues each command for the server; native application stays local-only (no link, no wire change)
command_contract.starter_states: RCS/wheels on, gear down, chutes safe; default runs issue no commands and reproduce the previous trajectory exactly
command_contract.excluded: named bank/chassis/leg systems, per-canopy commands, propellant transfer, throttles-by-name; server forwarding; assists

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians; no speedup claimed, no adapter tax isolated

live_offscreen.telemetry: throttle=1.000 engine=true control_mode=Navball sas=true rcs=true wheels=true gear=true chutes=false
live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand (no part commands issued by default) + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated command cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera cover between orbit/chase; not equal-scene runs and not Bevy parity; trajectory (not pixels) is the identity

verification.new_regressions: starter states, every toggle round-trip, absolute HUD adoption, change-only application, old-pilot key parity, no-op without flight, extended telemetry keys
verification.review: local command ownership, explicit-command semantics, no-command default trajectory identity, HUD spam avoidance, GPL/MIT separation

native_wayland_smoke.telemetry: throttle=1.000 engine=true control_mode=Navball sas=true rcs=true wheels=true gear=true chutes=false
native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server executable absent: existing local fallback; old-client command ownership untouched; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not audio/network validation or equal-scene parity

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame
actual local authority at 10.5s with the systems panel (RCS/wheels on, gear DOWN, chutes safe)
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot, command ownership untouched; not equal-scene parity

limitations: Local-only application: no server forwarding, fleet snapshots, named-bank/chassis/leg systems, per-canopy commands or propellant transfer in the native viewer.
Survey/map camera still legacy; materials remain base-color/Lambert without PBR/shadows/atmosphere parity; assists and mode HUD stay old-client-only.
Captures are not visual acceptance or equal-scene Bevy parity.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
